description: This file defines a mock class for the IAuthenticate interface used in unit testing, specifically in the context of the Thunder framework. It uses Google Mock to define mock methods for authentication-related functions.

classes.name: MockIAuthenticate
classes.description: A mock implementation of the WPEFramework::PluginHost::IAuthenticate interface used for testing authentication functionalities.

methods.description: Mocks the method to create an authentication token based on provided parameters.
